title: The  Spectral Pack
description: A modpack made especially for use on The Spectral Realm
body: This is a mod pack designed specifically for use of client side only mods. Some mods add various HUD improvements, changes to the F3 screen, simple tweaks to crafting, sorting chests, and mouse tweaks. Changes to the loading screen, Brightness, and menus. There is a map mod, a camera mod, and animation mods. Lighty helps with figuring out if mobs will spawn. Other mods that help optimize the entire Minecraft experience. These are again, all client side mods that make the game better in my opinion. You can choose to turn off some of the mods if you wish. If you play on a vanilla server with this pack it will still work as none of these mods have to be on the server to play. This pack is made for use on The Spectral Realm Server. To join our server visit our website at http://www.thespectralrealm.com .
